0022600103.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-1) host the Portland Trail Blazers (1-0) in the Kings' second game of the season, with Sacramento 4th in the Pacific and 14th in the West, 1 game back in its division, while Portland is 1st in the Northwest and 1st in the West. Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated), and Malik Monk is day-to-day with ankle soreness and a game-time decision, while Portland is missing Branden Carlson (concussion), Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Kings lost the season series 0-4, including a 122-110 loss in Portland on April 12, 2026.
